meta.title: Mōchirīī Monthly Raffle
meta.intro: Mōchirīī holds monthly drawings for eligible guild members.

entryModel.standardEntrySummary: One eligible monthly opt-in provides one standard entry.
entryModel.bonusEntrySummary: Members may earn up to nine optional bonus entries through the standing participation methods below.
entryModel.noPurchaseNotice: No purchase necessary. Entries are free; purchases, payments, donations, and subscriptions never improve eligibility, entry counts, or odds.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Guild activity
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Attend one guild activity, such as Breaking Army or Showdown.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or complete the monthly activity check-in.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Help session
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Join or host one help session, such as PvP training or build support.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or submit one written PvP or build-support tip.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Social photo or video
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Share one original photo or video on a social account with a clear monthly-drawing disclosure.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or submit the same original photo or video privately to the guild.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Guild feedback
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or suggest one practical guild improvement.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Community welcome
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Welcome one new or returning member in a guild community channel.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or send one private welcome note for leaders to share.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Guild recruitment
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Recruit one new verified guild member who voluntarily identifies you as their referrer.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or submit one practical recruitment idea.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Creative contribution
permanentBonusMethods.primaryPath: Share one original artwork or real-life hobby moment on Mōchirīī Social.
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or submit the same original work privately to the guild.

permanentBonusMethods.title: Member appreciation
permanentBonusMethods.equivalentFreePath: Or nominate one member for the monthly spotlight.

noAdvantageRules: Completing both paths in one pair never earns two bonus entries.
One activity or submission may satisfy only one bonus method.
A public social contribution must clearly disclose that it is connected to a monthly drawing; the private path earns the same single entry.
Recruitment credit applies only when a newly verified member voluntarily identifies the referring member. Unsolicited or repeated invitations do not qualify.
Alternative-response text is used only to verify completion, reduced to non-reversible evidence, and then discarded.
Follows, daily logins, and early entry never improve entry counts or odds.
entryModel.oddsFormula: A member's valid entries divided by all valid entries after the drawing closes.

rewards.summary: Drawing rewards may include digital gifts, approved in-game gifts, and Mōchirīī community honors.
rewards.activeDrawingNotice: Each active drawing identifies the exact primary reward, value, eligible locations, delivery method, redemption terms, and available choices in its official rules.

categories.title: Digital gift cards
categories.description: Eligible electronically delivered gift-card choices described in the active drawing rules.

categories.title: Virtual prepaid rewards
categories.description: Eligible virtual prepaid choices where the active drawing's approved locations and redemption terms allow them.

categories.title: Community membership upgrades
categories.description: Eligible digital membership upgrades for community features described in the active drawing rules.

categories.title: In-game gifts
categories.description: Approved in-game items, game credit, or other eligible digital game choices described in the active drawing rules.

categories.title: Guild commendation
categories.description: A community honor recognizing a member's contribution to the guild.

categories.title: Hall record
categories.description: A community honor recorded with the completed drawing for guild members to remember.

eligibility: Verified Mōchirīī guild member in good standing, age 18 or older, resident of a country approved for that drawing, and limited to one account and one opt-in per person per cycle.
standingPrinciples: Published odds are a member's valid entries divided by all valid entries after the drawing closes.
Each drawing has separate official rules stating its dates, eligibility, reward, value, claim period, expiration, and any location restrictions.
Each completed drawing confirms one primary winner, two community-honor recipients, and predetermined alternates without replacement.
Potential winners must retrieve rewards through the authenticated Mōchirīī claim page within seven days after the drawing unless the active drawing rules lawfully require a different period.
Private claim reminders may be sent when approximately 72 hours and 24 hours remain.
Electronic rewards expire 30 days after issue unless the active drawing rules lawfully state a different term.

During an active drawing, authenticated verified members may see participating members' guild display names, rank, and current point totals. Signed-out and unverified visitors cannot access the standings.
Signed-out visitors see only Winner confirmed or Community honor confirmed. Authenticated guild members may see each recipient's selected guild display name.

results.emptyMessage: No completed drawing result is available.
